name: vocabuilder
title: VocaBuilder
description: Translate words between languages and build your vocabulary
author: AngryBeaver

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.description: Translate a word or text to your target language

commands.name: flashcards
commands.title: View Flashcards
commands.subtitle: VocaBuilder
commands.description: Review saved words with spaced repetition

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: AI service used for translation and pronunciation. Auto-detect picks Gemini, Anthropic or OpenAI from the API key prefix; choose a provider explicitly for any other key.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Key for your provider. Auto-detect recognizes Gemini (AIza…), Anthropic (sk-ant-…) and OpenAI (sk-…) keys. Local servers that need no key accept any value.

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: API Server URL
preferences.description: Advanced. Leave empty to use the provider's official endpoint; required for an OpenAI-Compatible Server. Accepts a server root or a full API base, for example http://localhost:11434/v1 or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Your API key is sent to this host. Do not include credentials or a query string. Plain http is accepted only for local addresses (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1], 0.0.0.0).

preferences.name: sourceLanguage
preferences.title: Default Source Language
preferences.description: Used before you pick a language pair from the Translate dropdown

preferences.name: targetLanguage
preferences.title: Default Target Language
preferences.description: Used before you pick a language pair from the Translate dropdown

preferences.name: translationModel
preferences.title: Translation Model
preferences.description: Model ID used for translation. Leave empty for the provider default: gemini-3.5-flash-lite (Gemini), claude-haiku-5-5 (Anthropic), gpt-6-luna (OpenAI). Required for an OpenAI-Compatible Server.

preferences.name: ttsModel
preferences.title: Text-to-Speech Model
preferences.description: Model ID used for word pronunciation. Leave empty for the provider default: gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview (Gemini), gpt-4o-mini-tts (OpenAI). Anthropic and OpenAI-Compatible Servers use the macOS system voice. OpenAI tts-1 and tts-1-hd also use the system voice to preserve the selected language.

preferences.name: pronunciation
preferences.title: Pronunciation
preferences.description: Provider voice uses Gemini or OpenAI speech and falls back to the macOS system voice when it is unavailable. Other providers always use the macOS system voice.

preferences.name: readClipboardOnOpen
preferences.title: Read Clipboard on Open
preferences.label: Enable
preferences.description: If enabled, prefill a suggestion only when clipboard content is a safe word or short phrase

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
scripts.eval: mkdir -p evals/results && promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.yaml --filter-providers '^vocabuilder-gemini$' -o evals/results/promptfoo.json
scripts.eval:smoke: mkdir -p evals/results && promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.yaml --filter-providers '^vocabuilder-gemini$' --filter-sample 10 -o evals/results/promptfoo-smoke.json
scripts.eval:all: mkdir -p evals/results && promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.yaml -o evals/results/promptfoo-all.json
